help.title: About Dub Studio
help.intro: Dub Studio dubs and translates any video entirely on your machine — nothing leaves your computer. Drop a clip; it auto-analyzes once, then you fine-tune every detail with a live preview.
how: Drop an MP4/MOV — it splits the audio, recognizes speech, tells speakers apart, translates, and reads on-screen text.
Pick a mode — subtitles, full dub, voice-over, funny remix or transcript; mix audio, subtitles and blur freely.
Edit anything — transcript, voices, subtitle style, masks, add your own lines — with instant preview.
Export the finished video. Everything runs locally on your GPU.
features: Voice cloning, auto-cast per speaker, or a voice pack
Rewrite the script and re-dub (funny mode)
Subtitle styling: font, color, outline, shadow, plate
Mask covers: blur or a solid rectangle over the original
Composable modes — dub without subtitles, subtitles without dubbing, any mix
Add your own lines to the transcript — voiced in the speaker's cloned voice
sections: Transcript — edit each line and its translation
Voice — pick how it's voiced and regenerate
Settings (⚙) — the model stack (ASR / LLM / Vision / TTS)
help.donateIntro: I build open-source software and do AI research. Most of what I create is free and available to everyone. Your donations help me keep creating and researching without worrying about where the next meal comes from =) Thank you 🙏

setup.title: First run
setup.subtitle: Dub Studio needs a few components before the first dub. Everything needed is already checked — just click Download.
setup.pickNote: What's needed is already checked. Quants are variants of the same model (OR): higher quant = better quality and heavier, lower = lighter. No need to download them all.
setup.quantHint: One variant per model. Higher quant = better quality, more VRAM and disk; lower = lighter.
setup.reinstallHint: Ships with the app — reinstall if missing

comp.langHint: 100+ languages. For a non-European source, Whisper turns on automatically.
comp.asrSwitched: Parakeet doesn't know {{lang}} — ASR switched to Whisper (99 languages).
comp.detectHint: OCR finds baked-in captions to blur & localize. Slow on 4K — turn off if you don't need it (e.g. dubbing without subtitles).
comp.castingHint: Optional. Adds a pass over the frames — detects faces, matches them to speakers, and builds a character cast (avatar, name, voice) you can edit after analysis. Slower on long videos.
comp.hint: Compose freely — audio and subtitles are independent, in any mode
comp.audioNoneHint: Keep the original soundtrack — no voice is generated.
comp.audioDubHint: Replace the speech with a generated voice in the target language.
comp.audioVoiceoverHint: Translated voice on top of the quieted original.
comp.audioTranscribeHint: Only recognize speech and split it by speaker — no dubbing.
comp.subsTranslateHint: Subtitles translated into the target language.
comp.optionsHelp: Hover an option to see what it does
comp.burnHint: Burn subtitles/titles onto the video (off = clean video, e.g. dub without subtitles)
comp.voiceHint: Choose voice: clone / auto-cast / from pack

audio.onlyHint: No video track. Edit the transcript, pick voices, then Export to get the dubbed audio (WAV).

import.subsHint: Already have subtitles? Upload them — we take their text and timing as the base instead of auto-recognition (speakers assigned automatically, then translate & voice).
import.translated: Subtitles already in the target language (no translation)
import.translatedHint: E.g. English video + Russian subtitles → Russian dub. Subtitle text goes straight to voicing; ASR and translation are skipped.
